chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ja'far ibn Ali, who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) prostrating after the prayer, so he spread his arms upon the ground and pressed his forehead to the ground in his supplication.
ai.seo_question: How did the Imam perform prostration after prayer according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi illustrates the profound humility (khushu') of Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) by detailing his specific posture during post-prayer supplication, where he spread his arms and pressed his forehead firmly to the ground. This physical manifestation of devotion underscores the Shia emphasis on imitating the Ahl al-Bayt's ritual practices to achieve spiritual closeness to Allah. The act serves as a practical model for believers, linking physical prostration with intense spiritual supplication.
